About Dr. Tammy

A regular gal with a doctorate and a calling

I'm a daughter, first-born, type-A leader, loving wife, advising mother, and doting Grammy. I'm also a Doctor of Ministry—and the founder of One Heart One Hope Coaching. But that's not the whole story.

For years I lived like so many of the people I now serve: doing all the right things, believing all the right truths, and still feeling the weight of something unresolved underneath. My healing journey became the foundation for everything I do. I developed tools from my own experience of radical healing—bringing Biblical truth to the center of every memory, trauma, and wounded place, and allowing Jesus to heal what no plan or program ever could.

I defended my doctoral dissertation in March 2026: Trauma Transformation Coaching: A Biblically Based, Jesus-Centered, Spirit-Led Coach Approach to Healing the Brokenhearted—Body, Soul, and Spirit. Six years of research. A lifetime of experience.

I've spoken to handfuls of people in cozy rooms and to 1,400 pastors in an open-air building in Africa. I've coached across America, Canada, Spain, Thailand, and Tanzania. But my greatest joy? Sitting with one person and watching God bring transformation to the brokenhearted. He's done it for me. He can do it for you, too.

D.Min. — Trauma Transformation PCC · ICF NLP & RVT Certified Ordained Minister · 24 years M.A. · AGTS Evangel University
"What you think of yourself may not be the truth. It may be a lie you have believed—and that lie has a root. Let's find it together."
— Dr. Tammy Young

The Framework

Lead With Wholeness™

I believe God desires more than simply helping us survive what we've been through. He wants to restore what has been wounded, bring truth to the places where we've believed lies, and help us become who He created us to be.

That's what Lead With Wholeness™ is about.

One Heart One Hope Coaching exists to help men and women who know God has more for them — but unhealed wounds are still driving the wheel, keeping them stuck in cycles of addiction, anxiety, anger, or fear. Through our two pathways — Restore Within and Lead Unbound — we identify the root behind the patterns, replace lies with truth, and equip clients with practical tools to move forward and lead from a place of genuine wholeness.

Without reliving the past. Without burning out. The result is a person who thinks differently, responds differently, and finally has the internal freedom to pursue — and lead — the life God created them for.

There is no guilt. No shame. No blame. We simply get real about what's there — and invite God into the process.

Two Pathways. One Journey Toward Wholeness.

Where does your journey begin?

Some people enter because they're hurting. Some enter because they're leading. And some discover that before they can lead forward, there is something within that God wants to restore. Both pathways are part of the same journey.

Healing Pathway

Restore Within

Healing what has been wounded. Restoring what has been lost.

You can move forward without pretending the past didn't happen.

Restore Within is a safe, Spirit-led space to look honestly at the experiences, wounds, beliefs, and patterns that may still be affecting the way you see yourself, your relationships, your decisions, and your future.

You are not trying to become someone else. You're becoming freer to live as the person God created you to be.

No guilt. No shame. No blame.

Begin → Journey → Deepen
Explore Restore Within →
Leadership Pathway

Lead Unbound

Leading from wholeness, freedom, and God-given purpose.

Healthy leadership begins on the inside.

You can have the title, the responsibility, the calling — and still find yourself leading from exhaustion, old wounds, unhealthy expectations, fear, or the pressure to keep everyone else okay.

Lead Unbound is about becoming the kind of leader who knows who she is, understands what she carries, and learns to lead from a place of greater freedom, clarity, and wholeness.

Because leadership isn't simply about what you accomplish — it's about who you're becoming while you lead.

Discover → Develop → Multiply
Explore Lead Unbound →

Sometimes we need to Restore Within
before we can Lead Unbound.

Sometimes leadership itself reveals places within us that still need God's healing. And sometimes the two journeys happen together. That's the heart behind Lead With Wholeness™ — helping people heal what has been wounded, become more fully who God created them to be, and move forward with freedom and purpose.

Restore Within → Wholeness → Lead Unbound

The Work

Trauma does not define
who you are.

Our soul is our mind, our will, and our emotions. Trauma takes root there. And that's exactly where Jesus does His deepest healing work — not on the surface, not with a new plan, but at the very place where the pain began.

You are a tri-fold being: body, soul, and spirit. Healing that doesn't reach all three is incomplete. This work goes all the way down.

Start the Conversation

God loves you and has a good plan for your life.

God does not waste anything you walk through.

You can trust God because He has always been with you.

What To Expect

You don't have to figure out
the next step alone.

Here's exactly what happens when you reach out. No surprises. No pressure. Just a clear, safe path forward.

01

You Reach Out

Fill out the contact form and tell me a little about where you are. You don't have to have the right words. Just start where you are — that's enough.

02

We Connect

Within 48 hours, my team will reach out to schedule your complimentary discovery call. This is a relaxed, no-pressure conversation — a chance for us to get acquainted and for me to understand where you are and what you're carrying.

03

We Find Your Pathway

Together, we'll identify whether Restore Within, Lead Unbound, or a combination of both is the right starting place for you. There's no wrong answer — just the right next step for where you are right now.

04

The Work Begins

We begin at the root. Every session is Spirit-led, confidential, and tailored to you. We go at a pace that honors where you are — and we don't stop until freedom is the result.

Frequently Asked Questions

You probably have questions.
That's a good sign.

It means you're taking this seriously. Here are the ones I hear most often.

No. Coaching and therapy are different. Therapy is typically focused on diagnosing and treating mental health conditions and is conducted by a licensed mental health professional. Coaching — including trauma transformation coaching — is focused on helping you identify what's holding you back, addressing it at the root, and moving forward with clarity and freedom. If you need a licensed therapist, I will always tell you so. But for many people, what they need is exactly what coaching provides: a safe, Spirit-led space to get real, go deep, and experience genuine transformation.

My work is deeply rooted in Biblical truth and the belief that Jesus is the healer of the brokenhearted. That said, I meet people where they are. If you are open to exploring faith as part of your healing journey, there is a place for you here. If you have questions, doubts, or are simply curious — that's okay too. What matters most is that you are ready to get honest about what's happening inside.

Every session is different because every person is different. Generally, we begin by checking in on where you are, then we go to work — identifying patterns, beliefs, memories, or wounds that are keeping you stuck. I use a combination of Trauma Transformation Coaching™, NLP, timeline work, inner healing, and Spirit-led tools tailored to what you need in that moment. Sessions are conducted virtually via video call. They are always confidential, always safe, and always focused on moving you toward freedom.

Healing is not a program you graduate from. Some people experience profound breakthroughs in a very short time. Others need more sustained support as they work through deeper layers. What I can tell you is this: we don't rush, and we don't stop until something real has shifted. The discovery call is a great opportunity to talk through what a realistic timeline might look like for your specific situation.

That's one of the most honest questions I get — and I love it. Here's what I've found: many people have done tremendous amounts of good work and still feel stuck because the root has not been addressed. We can manage symptoms, build better habits, and even experience genuine moments of relief — and still have something unresolved underneath. My work is specifically designed to go to that root. Not to replace what you've already done, but to get to the place that hasn't yet been healed.

Absolutely. Everything you share with me is held in complete confidence — including conversations, disclosures, and personal history. This is a safe place, not just as a professional commitment, but as a personal one. You will never have to wonder whether what you've shared is going further than this space. That safety is foundational to the work we do together.

Confidentiality will be maintained except in the following limited circumstances: you provide written authorization for us to share specific information; disclosure is required by applicable law; or certain topics may be shared anonymously and hypothetically with other coaching professionals for training, consultation, or research purposes — in which case, no identifying information will ever be disclosed.

One important distinction: coaching through One Heart One Hope Coaching is not therapy, counseling, psychotherapy, psychoanalysis, mental health treatment, or substance abuse treatment, and does not involve the diagnosis or treatment of mental disorders as defined by the American Psychiatric Association. Dr. Tammy Young does not function as a licensed mental health professional. If you require mental health support, we will always encourage you to seek appropriate professional care.

It's for both — and often the line between the two is thinner than we'd like to admit. Many of the leaders I work with came to me because something in their leadership felt off: exhaustion, reactivity, patterns they couldn't break, a sense that they were leading from a deficit rather than a place of wholeness. What we discovered together is that leadership challenges often have a personal root. Lead Unbound is specifically designed for leaders who are ready to lead from a healthier, freer place — and who understand that the work begins on the inside.

If you're asking that question, you're probably closer to ready than you think. Readiness doesn't mean having it all figured out. It means being willing — willing to be honest, willing to go to the uncomfortable places, and willing to trust that God can meet you there. You don't have to have the words. You don't have to have a plan. You just have to be willing to begin.
